ON CONFLICT(serviceId) DO UPDATE SET lastNotification = ?`, [serviceId, token, timestamp, timestamp], (err) => { if (err) { return reply.status(500).send({ error: 'Internal server error.' }); } reply.send({ message: 'Heartbeat registered successfully.' }); }); }); // Get overview of registered services fastify.post('/services', async (request, reply) => { const { token } = request.body; if (!token) { return reply.status(400).send({ error: 'Invalid request payload.' }); } db.all(`SELECT serviceId, lastNotification FROM services WHERE token = ?`, [token], (err, rows) => { if (err) { return reply.status(500).send({ error: 'Internal server error.' }); } reply.send(rows); }); }); // Start the server const start = async () => { try { await fastify.listen({ port: 5000, host: '0.0.0.0' }); console.log('Server is running on http://0.0.0.0:5000'); } catch (err) { fastify.log.error(err); process.exit(1); } }; start();
